source.title: Elixir of Insight
source.description: The elixir is ready, <name>. Go down to the bonfire, on the beach, and drink it. Heed the vision given to you by the spirits, and return to me with your findings.
source.objective:
Drink the Elixir of Insight near the bonfire at Zoram'gar Outpost, and witness the vision it grants you.

Provided item:
source.progress: What did the spirits reveal to you, <name>?
source.completion: A quilboar <class> ... enslaving elementals? This is certainly troubling.
